principle: One live authority for each mechanism. Multiple states, species, art drafts and measured outcomes are permitted; competing runtime definitions are not.

costedCourtshipPerformance.note: Per-action finite ritual and optional target-specific reception; rival winner is only a preference, never a reproductive veto.

courtshipActionCapabilities.note: Five ritual action capabilities require actual mounted part definitions; approach never requires part.

learnedRituals.note: Per-animal bounded learning and witnessed success; no species-specific fixed script. Only simulation.tryMate performs conception.

physicalBreedingFieldGuide.note: Read-only display of actual mounted parts and parent body plan snapshots; mating/crossover unchanged.

eggNestsCarePredation.note: Finite optional nests/energy/vegetation, one care action per nest-day and hunter egg consumption. Simulation alone owns egg birth/hatch, world remains vegetation authority.

nativePartArtwork.note: Art-only runtime catalog; single indexed codec and procedural fallback; part identity and biological properties remain in part-registry.js. First wave is only 14 face/mouth parts.

nonRuntimeModules.src/render/authored-draft-compiler.js: creature art lab draft compiler; does not publish art to the live part catalog
nonRuntimeModules.src/ui/food-choice-view.js: read-only legacy food selection view retained for compatibility tests; persistent commands use canonical interaction options
nonRuntimeModules.src/lineage/phenotype-resolver.js: legacy Phase A compatibility/reference adapter exercised by evolution and creature assembly contract tests
nonRuntimeModules.src/render/fauna.js: Retired fixed-creature renderer retained for legacy presentation tests and historical source evidence only; live gameplay and current exports use inherited body plans with genvo-draw.js.

derivedReferences.references/generated-sprite-sheets: exported images generated from gameplay render functions; never gameplay imports
derivedReferences.tools/creature-lab: isolated authoring UI for editable source art; its drafts are not automatically installed

historicalArtifacts: reports/ stores historical observations and preserved experiment evidence, not executable runtime authority. No historical results may be silently rewritten.
browserExport: tools/export-public.mjs (uses tools/source-graph.mjs, shared with the audit)
releasePolicy: A development checkpoint is not a stable release; stable manifest may only be updated after full acceptance.
